svg.title: MaldiBatchKit batch-effect correction
svg.desc: Animated scatter plot of 54 MALDI-TOF spectra from three acquisition sites (colours) and three species (marker shapes). Before correction the samples form three clusters, one per site. After MaldiBatchKit the site colours are mixed and the samples form three clusters, one per species: the site effect is removed and the species signal is preserved. The animation loops between the two states.
